 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The penultimate weekend of the 2026 regular season features one matchup between teams ranked in the Top 25 of the College Football Playoff rankings, but that doesn't mean we won't have any good games.
 There's always room for a few upsets and surprises, especially with several highly ranked teams playing on the road. Which teams will stay alive in the playoff race and which teams will play themselves out of the mix?
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here are the games we'll be watching closely in Week 12.
 No. 11 Wake Forest at Georgia Tech (Noon ET, ESPN) 
 No. 14 Ohio State at Nebraska (Noon ET, Fox) 
 No. 10 BYU at Kansas (Noon ET, ABC) 
 No. 15 Iowa at Illinois (2:30 p.m. ET, Big Ten Network) 
 No. 8 Indiana at Washington (3:30 p.m. ET, Peacock) 
 No. 4 UCLA at Michigan (3:30 p.m. ET, CBS) 
 LSU at No. 9 Tennessee (3:30 p.m. ET, ABC) 
 SMU at No. 6 Notre Dame (7:30 p.m. ET, NBC) 
 No. 1 Georgia at No. 21 South Carolina (7:30 p.m. ET, ABC) 
 No. 2 Utah at TCU (9 p.m. ET, Fox) 
 Follow along below for updates, highlights and analysis on all the key games throughout Saturday. 
 Live 29 updates Sat, Nov 21, 2026 07:01 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Scoreboard update
 With most of the first wave of games coming back from halftime now, here's how things stand at the moment:
 Nebraska 21, OSU 14
BYU 9, Kansas 6
Wake Forest 36, Georgia Tech 7 
Vandy 24, Florida 17
Houston 14, West Virginia 10
Virginia 17, UNC 7
Cincinnati 21, Colorado 14
Minnesota 14, Northwestern 7
Wisconsin 21, Purdue 10
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:42 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Jeremiah Smith!
 The Buckeyes' star WR has another first-half TD and this one is a beauty. Look at how he got his feet inbounds on this 31-yard catch:
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:36 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Trinidad Chambliss' day against Wofford is already over
 Chambliss made easy work against Ole Miss' FCS opponent. The QB was 19-of-20 passing for 367 yards and five touchdowns before Deuce Knight took over in the first half.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:27 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Georgia Tech's TD is the first first-half points against Wake Forest in over a month
 You have to go back to Wake's 38-14 win over NC State on Oct. 10 to find the last opponent to score in the first half against the Demon Deacons.
 They lead the Yellow Jackets 29-7 with five minutes to go before halftime.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:26 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Nebraska!
 The Huskers now have a two-possession lead after Anthony Colandrea dove for the pylon and scored a touchdown.
 Nebraska came to play today. Will it finally picked up a win over a ranked team for Matt Rhule?
 Nebraska 21, OSU 7 | 4:12 left in Q2 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:24 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Halftime: Kansas 6, BYU 3
 The Cougars tied things up with a few minutes to go in the half, but the Jayhawks responded with a last-second field goal of their own to take the lead into the break.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:18 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Alabama's Keelon Russell out, Austin Mack to start at QB
 The Tide are playing Chattanooga and surely don't need star QB Keelon Russell, who's been nursing an ankle injury, so Austin Mack will get the start.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:17 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Florida's defense delivers TD
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:12 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Fumble recovered by Nebraska!
 The Huskers have it right back after a fumble by Isaiah West was recovered by Nebraska in a pile of bodies.
 We're midway through the second quarter and Nebraska will take over at midfield.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:03 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Nebraska!
 The Huskers have the lead after a 13-play, 70-yard drive culminated in a short TD pass from Anthony Colandrea to Kwazi Gilmer.
 Nebraska 14, OSU 7 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 06:00 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Watch Wake Forest's Jack Foley make it 22-0
 The Georgia Tech defender trying to make a play on the pass was … not even close.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:56 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Jeremiah Smith's Heisman odds are even better
 Smith entered Saturday's game at -200 at BetMGM. His odds are now at -500 to win the Heisman following that 67-yard TD catch on the first drive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:53 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff End of Q1: Nebraska 7, OSU 7
 The Cornhuskers have cobbled together another impressive drive and are in scoring range again as the first quarter comes to a close.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:48 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Wake!
 It's now 15-0 after the Demon Deacons capped off that drive with a short TD run by QB Gio Lopez. They went for 2 and got it.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:43 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Wake Forest in control early
 The Demon Deacons opened the scoring early with a long drive capped off by a Ty Clark TD and, on the ensuing possession, they recovered a fumble near midfield.
 They're in scoring range again with just over 4 minutes left in the first quarter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:38 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Kansas up 3-0 early on BYU
 The Jayhawks need to pull the upset on the Cougars today and win in Week 13 to get to the postseason.
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:35 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Nebraska strikes back!
 The Huskers have responded with a touchdown of their own, capping off a 13-play, 63-yard drive with an 11-yard TD pass from Anthony Colandrea to Luke Lindenmeyer.
 OSU 7, Nebraska 7 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:23 PM UTC Nick Bromberg That's why Jeremiah Smith is the Heisman favorite
 Why in the world would Nebraska's defense be playing man coverage on Jeremiah Smith on a third down?
 With no one else really making a charge — unless Devon Dampier can keep powering Utah to an unbeaten season — Smith is going to be the guy hoisting the award in New York City in a few weeks even without Julian Sayin on the field for the second half of the season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:21 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Touchdown Ohio State!
 Who else but Jeremiah Smith to get things started this week!
 The Heisman frontrunner just blew past the Nebraska defense and Luke Fahey hit him with a 67-yard bomb to get the Buckeyes on the board first.
 OSU 7, Nebraska 0 
 Sat, Nov 21, 2026 05:03 PM UTC Yahoo Sports Staff Kickoff is here!
 We are underway with the first wave of games.
 We'll mostly be tracking OSU-Nebraska, BYU-Kansas and Wake Forest-Georgia Tech in this first window as the Buckeyes, Cougars and Demon Deacons all fight to stay in the playoff picture.
